decisions.reason: The source changes the link destination of the course-content navigation control; it does not alter the instructions for editing pricing-panel or pricing-button colors.
The course-content navigation control is separate from the mobile header YouTube icon, whose direct visibility requirement remains unchanged.
Linking the secondary course-content control to a lower section does not change the hero video's source, media type, or playback requirement.
The source concerns a separate course-content navigation label and does not change the hero block's layout or media-to-text relationship.
The source's reference to linking a control is unrelated to the Kajabi account migration, page-transfer obligation, or permitted transfer method.
